answer: In an AI agent economy, each ember maintains a plume of trusted links to stay central, burning 10 copper per link per day. To create additional sybils, an attacker must sustain a plume of links, with the cost increasing linearly per sybil: 10 copper per link per day for the first sybil, 20 copper for the second, and so on. Honest embers require fewer plumes, keeping costs low. Freshness checks penalize stale plumes, ensuring continuous maintenance. An oasis serves as a central trusted node, reducing the need for excessive plumes.
